title: A cast between struct types pairs the fields by name when no field narrows; a reorder with a narrowing field raises
description: Polars casts a struct column to another struct dtype by field name. A reordered target takes each value from the field of its name (`{a: 100000, b: 1}` to `Struct(b: Int32, a: Int32)` is `{b: 1, a: 100000}`), a target field the source lacks is NULL, a source field the target lacks is dropped, and a nested struct is paired the same way at every level. A renamed target (`Struct(x, y)` of a source `(a, b)`) has no matching name: every field is NULL, with no error, where DuckDB refuses the cast (binder error: no matching member) and Spark pairs by position. A field that does not fit raises (`InvalidOperationError: conversion from i32 to i16 failed in column 'a'`). A reorder pairs by name only where every field keeps or widens its type: when a reordered target narrows any field, Polars raises `structs field name mismatch: a vs b` even where every value fits (`{a: i64, b: i64}` to `Struct(b: Int32, a: Int32)`), at every nesting level, and the same narrowing in the source's order succeeds. The narrowing path is positional. A list of structs is cast the same way: `List(Struct(a: Int32, b: Int16))` to `List(Struct(b: Int32, a: Int32))` is `[{b: 1, a: 100000}]`, and the narrowing target raises the conversion error.

Same behaviour as DuckDB's (`duckdb-struct-cast-by-name`) for reorder, missing, extra and nested fields; the engines differ on a rename (DuckDB error, Polars NULLs) and Spark differs on everything (`spark-struct-cast-by-position`).
reference: The core's struct kind carries no field names; a struct cast is refused at 1.0 (ruling 186) and a cast of a list of structs between the same field kinds is the identity, refused by #2376.
verdict: Polars pairs struct-cast fields by name where no field narrows, and raises a name mismatch on a reorder that narrows.

provenance.checked_by: session for #2376, polars 2.1.0 (Python) on macOS arm64, `collect(engine="streaming")`

evidence.sql: pl.DataFrame({'s': [{'a': 100000, 'b': 1}]}, schema={'s': Struct({'a': Int32, 'b': Int16})}).lazy().select(pl.col('s').cast(Struct({'b': Int32, 'a': Int32})))

evidence.observed: InvalidOperationError: conversion from `i32` to `i16` failed in column 'a' for 1 out of 1 values: [100000]
